publisher: Ohio DOT, Office of Technical Services
coverage: statewide all public roads (state, county, township, municipal; ~418k segments)
license: no formal license; 'deemed to be public information', no-warranty disclaimer. OSM wiki cites ODOT email: 'No copyright applies to the data published by TIMS.'
notes: FeatureServer variant also exists (Road_Inventory/FeatureServer/0) and bulk download at https://gis.dot.state.oh.us/tims_classic/Data/Download (per OSM wiki, not opened). Separate Speed_Zones layer (Roadway_Information/Speed_Zones/MapServer/0) lists only ODOT-approved zones below statutory limits. Same field also in odotgis SafetyMapViewer/MapServer/1. Check how many local segments have SPEED_LIMIT_NBR populated.
